generatedBy: bun run evidence:attacks (apps/api test/attacks + test/naive, WRITE_EVIDENCE=1)
note: Per case: REFUSED = code stopped it, nothing to approve; ASKED = a passkey prompt on the exact canonical order, nothing moves unless the user approves (ifApproved says who would be paid; payeeCooling IN_COOLING = refused for 24 h even with approval, COOLED_UNVERIFIED = the wait is over and an approval pays); PAID = money reached the attacker. guarded = the real Kassa modules (rules, payments, Reader, webhooks) on PGlite with stub/mock rails. tapConfirm = a chatbot with a payment tool where every payment needs one confirm tap and nothing else (no cooling, verified payees, caps, mandate scope or order signature), with a fooled user who taps every card (the live-agent.md assumption). naive = the raw intent through a stub rail with no confirmation at all: it pays every case by construction and is shown only as the upper bound. No real AI: the planner and the Reader are scripted mock models.
